name: Cleansing
body:
Your channeled energy boosts the resilience of your allies.

Prerequisite: Channel energy

Benefit: Any creature healed by a use of your channel energy ability gains a resistance bonus to Fortitude saves against poison or disease. The bonus is equal to your Wisdom bonus (minimum +1), and lasts for one round for each die of healing dealt by your channel energy.
